label: Infectious Disease Outbreak
summary: Infectious diseases are illnesses caused by germs, such as viruses or bacteria. They can spread through people, food, water, or insects.

items.label: Keep recommended vaccines up to date
items.body: Follow NYC Health advice for the specific disease or outbreak.

items.label: Stay home when sick and wash hands often
items.body: For respiratory illness, use a well-fitting mask around others and improve airflow when safe.

items.label: Ask a healthcare provider early about testing and treatment, especially if you have a higher risk of serious illness
Severe trouble breathing or another medical emergency?

sections.title: Respiratory illness in New York City right now

items.label: Prevent and treat respiratory infections
items.body: Current advice on COVID-19, flu, and RSV, including vaccines, masks, and treatment. Translated factsheets.

items.label: Find vaccines near you
items.body: Search vaccine services. Confirm vaccine availability, age eligibility, cost, and hours with the provider.

items.label: Get healthcare if you are uninsured
items.body: Affordable care through NYC Health + Hospitals for eligible NYC residents. Call 646-692-2273; immigration status is no barrier. Interpreters and translated materials.

items.label: Learn about time off when you are sick
items.body: Protected time off for covered workers, including illness. Check current rules and reporting options. Translated worker materials.

items.label: Talk to an urgent care clinician remotely
items.body: 24/7 phone or video care. Call 631-397-2273; financial assistance is available. Phone and video language assistance.

items.label: Find a City hospital or health center
items.body: Care locations, appointments, and financial assistance for insured and uninsured patients. Includes Elmhurst and Queens hospitals.

items.label: Look up a disease and how it spreads
items.body: Disease facts, symptoms, and prevention. Use NYC alerts for instructions during a local outbreak.

items.label: Find low-cost City health clinics
items.body: Immunization, sexual health, and tuberculosis services, regardless of immigration status. Services and charges vary by clinic.

items.label: Check emergency medicine distribution information
items.body: Medicine or vaccines at temporary POD sites only when activated. Follow official locations; PODs do not treat people already sick.
